scope: Taloa Overlay A-to-Z from current partial foundation to a verified browser/ChatGPT observe-select-act-verify-context-continue loop. Abbott receives the same founder Point B as a continuation test: the factory must consume pre-authored lawful slices without silently becoming idle.
point_b: Taloa attaches to a real authenticated browser session, observes current state, selects the correct bounded action, acts through semantic/browser/app/visual/keyboard control trees, verifies the result, updates receipts/context, and continues a multi-turn ChatGPT conversation without ordinary founder clicks; runtime truth exposes current state and blockers.
continuation_invariant: If all authored slices are exhausted while Point B is false, emit BLUEPRINT_EXHAUSTED and return immediately to Architecture. IDLE is not a successful terminal state.
factory_rule: Factories traverse this decision tree; they do not invent the next slice.

steps.title: Build structured Overlay observation engine
steps.task: Implement a dependency-light observation engine that converts a browser/UI snapshot into a structured scene containing page identity, visible controls, composer/input state, dialogs, permission prompts, latest assistant state, generating/working state, and evidence timestamps. Export createOverlayObservationEngine. No secrets, no network calls, no random actions.
steps.spec: Export createOverlayObservationEngine with observe(snapshot) and classify(snapshot). Every observation must include observed_at, evidence, confidence, and current actionable candidates.

steps.title: Build grounded target selector
steps.task: Implement deterministic target selection over observation candidates. Prefer semantic DOM/accessibility evidence, choose the current/bottom-most ChatGPT approval frontier when applicable, reject stale/historical candidates, return confidence/evidence and a typed LOW_CONFIDENCE blocker rather than guessing. Export createOverlayTargetSelector.
steps.spec: Export createOverlayTargetSelector with select(observation,intent). Never return an action target without evidence and confidence.

steps.title: Build bounded multi-tree action router
steps.task: Implement a bounded action router with ordered control trees: DOM/accessibility, browser/Chrome automation, app-specific hook, visual/coordinate fallback, keyboard fallback. Support click/tap/press, focus, type, select, scroll, navigate, submit, wait, switch target, back/forward, refresh. Require explicit authorization metadata for risky/irreversible actions. Export createOverlayActionRouter.
steps.spec: Export createOverlayActionRouter with plan(action,target,context) and execute(plan,adapters). Bounded fallback only; no silent success.

steps.title: Build post-action result verifier
steps.task: Implement result verification comparing pre-action observation, intended acceptance condition, and post-action observation. A click/type/send is never success by itself. Return VERIFIED, RETRY_BOUNDED, FALLBACK_REQUIRED, or HARD_CAPABILITY_BLOCKER with evidence. Export createOverlayResultVerifier.

steps.title: Build ChatGPT conversation adapter
steps.task: Implement the app-specific ChatGPT browser adapter over generic observation/action/verification contracts. Detect working state, current approval frontier, composer, latest assistant response, founder-attention tokens, and turn completion. Produce bounded next actions; do not perform irreversible external actions. Export createChatGPTBrowserConversationAdapter.
steps.spec: Adapter states include CHATGPT_WORKING, APPROVAL_REQUIRED_CURRENT, TURN_COMPLETE, FOUNDER_DECISION_REQUIRED, HARD_CAPABILITY_BLOCKER.

steps.title: Build Overlay runtime truth emitter
steps.task: Implement a read-only runtime truth state emitter for Taloa: body identity, commit/runtime fingerprint if provided, heartbeat freshness, current task/slice, last observation, last action, last verified result, blocker, receipt IDs, and UNKNOWN/OFFLINE on stale heartbeat. Export createOverlayRuntimeTruth.
steps.spec: No secrets. Stale heartbeat must never be inferred as idle.

steps.title: Build continuous observe-act-verify supervisor loop
steps.task: Compose observation engine, target selector, action router, result verifier, ChatGPT adapter, and runtime truth into the state machine OBSERVE -> SELECT -> ACT -> VERIFY -> UPDATE_CONTEXT -> CONTINUE. Terminal states only POINT_B_REACHED, FOUNDER_DECISION_REQUIRED, HARD_CAPABILITY_BLOCKER, BLUEPRINT_EXHAUSTED. Export createOverlayContinuationSupervisor. Include duplicate-action/turn guards and structured receipts.
steps.spec: The loop must never report idle-success while Point B is false.

steps.title: Build zero-deception A-to-Z acceptance harness
steps.task: Implement an acceptance harness that first tests the A-to-Z service contracts with deterministic fixtures, then clearly reports LIVE_SESSION_NOT_PROVEN unless explicit real authenticated-session evidence is supplied. It must never convert structural tests into an end-to-end PASS. PASS requires evidence for attach, observe, select, act, verify, context/receipt update, multi-turn continuation, runtime truth, and no ordinary founder clicking during the proof.
steps.spec: Verdicts: TECHNICAL_PARTIAL, LIVE_SESSION_NOT_PROVEN, PASS, HARD_CAPABILITY_BLOCKER. No deception.

completion_rule: Not complete until the acceptance command returns PASS from real authenticated evidence. Technical file presence is never Point B.

abbott_test.purpose: Founder-directed control experiment: give Abbott the executable Overlay blueprint and observe whether it advances slice by slice or silently quits.
abbott_test.success_signal: Post-blueprint factory commits/receipts advance TALOA-A2Z steps without founder wake-up.
abbott_test.failure_signal: No lawful slice claim/build while Point B is incomplete and no typed blocker is emitted.
